01

The core problems of city management

A modern city has complex infrastructure and a vast number of assets, and all of it needs constant monitoring. Traditional inspection methods deliver neither the speed nor the accuracy required.

Large area and a high density of assets
Manual inspection is slow and puts staff at risk
Camera blind spots and slow incident response
Scattered data and no single analytics layer
The result: slow response and high operational risk
